parameters.jsCode: const r=$json; for(const k of ['run_id','source_code','folder_id','senders','subjects','window_start']) if(r[k]===undefined||r[k]===null||r[k]==='') throw new Error(`Missing trusted contract field ${k}`); if(!Array.isArray(r.senders)||!r.senders.length||!Array.isArray(r.subjects)||!r.subjects.length) throw new Error('Trusted sender and subject allowlists are required'); const start=new Date(r.window_start); const upper=r.run_upper_bound?new Date(r.run_upper_bound):new Date(); if(!Number.isFinite(start.valueOf())||!Number.isFinite(upper.valueOf())||!(start<upper)||upper>new Date()) throw new Error('Invalid frozen cursor window'); return [{json:{...r,run_upper_bound:upper.toISOString(),senders:r.senders.map(v=>String(v).toLowerCase()),subjects:r.subjects.map(String)}}];

const c=$('Freeze Trusted Cursor Window').first().json; const start=new Date(c.window_start), upper=new Date(c.run_upper_bound); const enumerated=$input.all().map(i=>i.json).filter(j=>j&&j.id); const messages=enumerated.filter(j=>{const sender=String(j.from?.emailAddress?.address||j.sender?.emailAddress?.address||'').toLowerCase(); const received=new Date(j.receivedDateTime); return c.senders.includes(sender)&&c.subjects.includes(String(j.subject||''))&&received>=start&&received<upper;}).sort((a,b)=>String(a.receivedDateTime).localeCompare(String(b.receivedDateTime))||String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))); return [{json:{run_id:c.run_id,source_code:c.source_code,window_start:c.window_start,run_upper_bound:c.run_upper_bound,pagination_exhausted:true,pages_fetched:null,scanned_count:enumerated.length,matched_count:messages.length,heartbeat:messages.length===0,messages}}];
